verses.1: May the LORD bless David with the words of my song. Do not be angry.
verses.2: For my lips are those of a wicked person, and my tongue speaks lies. They speak evil against me.
verses.3: And the words of hatred made me angry, and they fought against me.
verses.4: Under my love, they will trample me, and I shall cry out in pain.
verses.5: They placed evil under good, and hatred under love.
verses.6: A wicked and evil man will stand on his right side.
verses.7: In his judgment, the wicked will be punished, and their prayers will become a source of sin.
verses.8: His days will be few; his troubles will continue.
verses.9: Their sons shall be young, and their wife shall be barren.
verses.10: And their sons will also move away from them, and they will ask and seek answers from their ruins.
verses.11: He will purify Noshah for everyone who belongs to him. And strangers will be driven away.
verses.12: May there be no mercy for him, and may he not be saved from his sins.
verses.13: It shall be after his brother’s death, in a different time. His name will be forgotten in that time.
verses.14: Let him remember the sins of his ancestors before Jehovah, and the sins of his mother, so that he may not be destroyed.
verses.15: They shall always be before Jehovah’s face, and His memory will be remembered from this earth.
verses.16: Because he did not remember to do what was right and kind. He continued to oppress poor people, widows, and orphans.
verses.17: And she loved evil; she came to him, but she did not desire his blessings. So she withdrew from him.
verses.18: And he was covered with curses, just as the waters are covered by mud. And when he tried to stand up, he could not do so.
verses.19: May it be a garment that can be thrown away, and always be tied up for use.
verses.20: This is the work of those who are evil against Jehovah, and they speak words that are harmful to my soul.
verses.21: And you, Jehovah my God, make this possible for me, so that your name may be praised. For your kindness is truly great; save me!
verses.22: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is empty within me.
verses.23: Like a reflection of his shadow, I walked and moved forward, like a child.
verses.24: In my lips, strength from smoke; in my voice, power from the smoke.
verses.25: And I became a source of shame for them; they feared me and were afraid of me.
verses.26: May Jehovah, my God, help me with His grace.
verses.27: And they shall know that it is You, LORD, who have done this.
verses.28: They have cursed them, but you will bless them. They stood up and worshipped you. They were happy to serve you.
verses.29: They will pluck out my thorns like leaves, and they will remove the dirt from them.
verses.30: May the LORD be glorified greatly in our mouths and among many people. We praise Him.
verses.31: For he will stand on the right side of his father to save his soul from judgment.
